{{Quote|This popular sandwich boasts sliced Manpha-fowl, nuna bacon, Revwien lettuce and topato. Served on toasted or therm-zapped pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Shawda Clubb sandwich with nuna bacon|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Bacon''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that came in strips. Its varieties included [[tailring bacon]] and [[nuna bacon]], both of which were served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner added four pieces of crispy [[tailring]] bacon to its [[Socorro slider]]s. Dex's Diner served two strips of [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] bacon with [[Anoat oat]]s as a breakfast [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran Plate Special]] as well as four strips nuna bacon as its own breakfast side dish. Nuna bacon also featured in the diner's [[Shawda Clubb sandwich]] and [[Besh-Leth-Trill sandwich]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Breakfast-DarthVaderAndSon.png|thumb|right|300px|Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker having a meal of eggs and bacon.]]
Bacon was first mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> In the [[2012]] picture book ''[[Darth Vader and Son]]'', written and illustrated by [[Jeffrey Brown]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] share a meal that consisted of [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] and strips of what resembles real&ndash;world [[Wikipedia:Bacon|bacon]].<ref name="Vader and Son">''[[Darth Vader and Son]]''</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', a [[2013]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[NimbleBit]] and published by [[LucasArts]], included an item called the [[Krayt bacon burger]]. In the game, the [[Burger/Legends|burger]] was sold from the restaurant [[Bantha Burger]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] during its construction.<ref name="Tiny Death Star">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
